items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: I knew Basie when he was with Gonzalo White, he stayed with her about 12 years.

ctx.x: President Harry Gray, he was with the band, uh, at that time. And, uh, Frazier, uh, when I, oh, they had, oh, I was the biggest Duke waiting by this. I came out of New York from the Black Fleet High Flyers. I came out of the White and Black River, I had 11 pieces of bands then. Duke didn't have but five. Well, he had a big band then, but I knew Duke when he had five pieces. I knew Basie when he was with Gonzalo White, he stayed with her about 12 years. But see, when I got sick, I had to go home. When I went out…
Did you play much in Chicago in the late 20s? No. I didn't do much playing here. I came came here at the hospital. But I think you know Jerome Carrington? He was the first musician I met.
